findings.issue: HeadObject returns the client-declared Content-Type, not the file's actual bytes; 'authoritatively validated' wording overstates the finalize check. Real content validation is the worker's music-metadata probe.

StorageService failure-timing prose is self-contradictory ('throws at construction time' vs 'fails fast on first use'). Constructor should not throw on missing env to avoid crashing the whole API on boot in dev.
findings.location: design 'env additions' note + StorageService code block

findings.issue: music-metadata parseWebStream requires converting the AWS SDK Node Readable to a Web ReadableStream (Body.transformToWebStream()); passing the Node stream directly won't work. Use parseBuffer or transformToWebStream().

Play recording runs as a blocking $transaction before the signed URL is returned; a transient DB error returns 500 and prevents playback. Consider making the PlaybackEvent write non-blocking (fire-and-forget or a separate job).

note: MEDIUM finding from iteration 2 (upload/cover endpoints lacking status guards) was addressed in design iteration 3: requestUploadUrl/finalizeUpload are now guarded to DRAFT/UPLOADING/PROCESSING_FAILED only; requestCoverUrl allows DRAFT and PUBLISHED (cover-only update). All remaining findings are LOW — non-blocking implementation notes for the coder. Design approved to unblock the build phase.
